summary: Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (100%) across Auth, Address Book CRUD, Site Settings, Banners, Coupons, Orders+Coupon. Frontend admin flow fully works (admin login at /portal-7x9k2m4p8q3z6n1v, Banners create, Coupons create, Settings tabs Payment/Site/Delivery). Customer signup works and Profile -> Addresses navigation works. However, the Add-Address modal is MISSING the documented data-testids and addr-save-btn, which blocks both the address-book add scenario and the entire downstream Checkout flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testids on form inputs and save button. Form has plain placeholder-only inputs (Full name, mobile, House / Road / Building, Area / Thana / Upazila, District, Division, Postal code, Note for rider) and a Save Address button without testid. Documented testids addr-label / addr-fullName / addr-phone / addr-address / addr-area / addr-save-btn do not exist. addr-add-btn-empty IS present.
Form inputs lack data-testid; only placeholders identify them (Full name, Email, Mobile number, Password ...).

No discoverable 'Add to cart' button via testid or text. Searched all <button> elements on home and on /products/pure-cow-ghee — none with cart-related testid or 'Add to cart' text. Likely icon-only without aria/text/testid, blocking automated cart flows.
Console error: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Checkout)'. Indicates setState during render — should be wrapped in useEffect.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete saved-address selection / coupon apply / COD confirm because (a) address could not be saved without addr-* testids and (b) Add-to-cart not reachable, so /checkout redirected to /cart (empty cart).

action_items: Add data-testids to AddAddress modal inputs (addr-label / addr-fullName / addr-phone / addr-address / addr-area / addr-city / addr-district / addr-division / addr-postalCode / addr-default-toggle) and save button (addr-save-btn) — as listed in the review request.
Add data-testid='product-add-to-cart' (and aria-label) to product card and product detail add-to-cart button so customer cart flow can be exercised by tests.
Fix Checkout setState-during-render warning (wrap navigate('/cart') redirect inside useEffect).
Add data-testids to Login / Signup form inputs and submit buttons for stable automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1090+ lines — split into routers/auth.py, routers/products.py, routers/orders.py, routers/admin.py for maintainability.
Backend signup gives token immediately and pushes a welcome notification — good. Coupon usedCount is correctly incremented atomically with $inc — verified.
Coupon apply route is protected by get_current_user — good, prevents anonymous coupon enumeration.
Address book stores addresses inside the user document. Default-promotion logic on delete works only if remaining list non-empty — verified. Auto-default on first address — verified.
Site settings PUT requires admin — verified. GET is public — correct.
Banner public list filters active=True and sorts by order — correct.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is technically inconsistent in many browsers; acceptable for demo but worth noting.

rca of the issue: Address form modal in Addresses.jsx and product Add-to-cart button render without data-testid attributes, breaking automated testability. Inputs in the modal rely solely on placeholder strings; the save button uses text 'Save address'. Recommended fix: add data-testid='addr-label-Home/Office/Other', addr-fullName, addr-phone, addr-address, addr-area, addr-city, addr-district, addr-division, addr-postalCode, addr-note, addr-default-toggle, addr-save-btn on respective elements. For products, add data-testid='product-add-to-cart' to the Add-to-cart button in ProductCard and ProductDetail components.
